message.content: Yes—geographically the United States occupies part of the continent of **North America**. It lies south of Canada, north of Mexico, and extends from the Atlantic Ocean (east) to the Pacific Ocean (west). Within North America, the U.S. shares borders with both Canada and Mexico and also has maritime boundaries with several other countries across the Caribbean Sea and Gulf of Mexico.
